name: @amykit/plugin-agent-relay
description: One agent made of several: swaps harness on a quota, escalates model on a failure.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Every install that runs an agent needs it, because it is the only plugin that mounts the agent port. It puts the harnesses that claude, codex and hermes-agent contribute on a ladder, moving to another harness when one runs out of quota and to a stronger model when a step fails, so mount at least one of those beside it. When you set a spending ceiling it also mounts the budget port, and it owns amy models, the price table that ceiling is measured with.
